signals.rule: Early warning: two or more independent first-hand reports of a serious hazard, or one whose photo shows fire, heat or swelling damage. Same person, same photo or copied words count once.
signals.status: early warning: sent for review by a person (not a recall)
summaries: Power bank melted and the casing burned while charging on a desk.

note: Shopper reports checked by Gemini and grouped by code. An early warning is not a recall.
